description: Trendgap.io is an AI-powered niche discovery platform designed to help indie hackers and SaaS founders identify high-pain market opportunities. By mining real user complaints from sources like Reddit, app store reviews, and forums, the platform transforms market noise into validated product blueprints. This data-driven approach ensures that builders focus on solving actual problems with proven demand rather than relying on guesswork. Data-Driven Niche Discovery The platform evaluates every niche
